title: NextLearnerEvent
description: A learner event in the shape the lexical model needs (docs/migration-design.md, deliverable 1): schema 2. Credit is per part and skill, a miss carries its labels, and what was shown is logged. Nothing writes or reads it until the switch, when every stored event is upgraded to it, it replaces learner-event.schema.json, and the `Next` names lose their prefix. No event stays in the old shape.

NextExerciseRef.title: NextExerciseRef
NextExerciseRef.description: What was presented: enough to recompute credit without the bundle.

item.description: What the exercise was built from: a sentence id, a lexeme id or a grapheme id.

reading.description: A reading card (char-read, reading-disambiguation, transcribe) of an orthography read in more than one tradition (lzh: Pinyin, Jyutping, Baxter; ADR 0138): the tradition it asked. Its read-script card is that tradition's own. Absent on every other card.

parts.description: The parts the exercise can give evidence of (ADR 0146).

PartCredit.title: PartCredit
PartCredit.description: What one answer says of one part (ADR 0146: credit is per part, and only where the card made the learner supply it): right, wrong, or given (handed over, so no evidence).

DisplayedLexeme.title: DisplayedLexeme
DisplayedLexeme.description: A lexeme a card or a story line showed, in the form it showed (ADR 0146: seen is logged, so a rule's branch can be asked on a pair never seen).

NextSessionStarted.title: NextSessionStarted
NextSessionStarted.description: A session began: a lesson (one path node), review, mistakes or placement.

placed.description: Placement only (§9.5): the lesson nodes the learner placed out of, in path order. The client computes it from the session's first tries; the projection marks them done. A test the learner stopped part-way (summary.completed false) places by its answers so far, still without the session's XP (D9 in the 2026-11 review).

seeded.description: Placement only (ADR 0111): the parts the placed nodes introduce. The projection gives each that has no card yet a recognize card, as if recalled with ease at the end of the session, so the planner counts them as seen, review brings them back at long intervals and the word list shows them.

NextOutcomeRevised.title: NextOutcomeRevised
NextOutcomeRevised.description: A later verdict on an earlier answer (§8.3): the LLM judge accepted it, or a reviewer did. Replay applies the revised outcome in place of the original, retroactively. Only the server issues these; uploads of ones it did not issue are refused.

NextAnswerReported.title: NextAnswerReported
NextAnswerReported.description: A learner's claim about how an answer was graded (§13.2, ADR 0052): "my answer should have been accepted" (claim accept, the default) or "this should have been wrong" (claim reject). It counts that way for the learner at once (projections apply it as a revision of the answer) and goes to the review queue for the course.

NextProgressReset.title: NextProgressReset
NextProgressReset.description: The learner started the course over: in its projection, everything before this event is forgotten (what they know, the lessons done, placement, mistakes). XP and the game state (streak, achievements) stay: they record practice that happened. The log keeps every earlier event.

NextSentenceReported.title: NextSentenceReported
NextSentenceReported.description: A learner marked a sentence, a story line or a word as incorrect and said what it should be (ADR 0051, 0057). A suggestion: it reaches the course only once a reviewer applies it (`nabu corrections apply`). A later report of the same item from the same device replaces this one. Projections of learning ignore it.

NextGoalSet.title: NextGoalSet
NextGoalSet.description: The learner set or cleared their weekly practice goal (ADR 0107, D12): a number of practice days a week. It is the account's, not a course's or a device's, so it names no course, bundle or session; every device shares it through the log. The latest by device time, then id, holds.
